address: 3F, Infinitus Mall, 168 Hubin Road, Huangpu, Shanghai, China Mainland
bio: Though moved into a shopping mall, the grey-brick façade is reminiscent of Shikumen architecture style. In stark contrast, the interior sports velvet sofas in gold and modern art for a touch of glamour. Start your night with creative cocktails from the bar. Then sample their Shanghainese classics like braised pork belly, sautéed shrimps with wild garlic, or xiao long bao. Try also hairy crab dishes such as stuffed crab shell when available....
